section.content: The invention provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a first conductive connecting part, a second conductive connecting part and a plurality of pole cores, wherein each pole core comprises an anode and a cathode, the anodes and the cathodes of all the pole cores are wound on the outer side of the first conductive connecting part, one of the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part is used for connecting and fixing a plurality of anodes, and the other of the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part is used for connecting and fixing a plurality of cathodes. The positive electrode of the pole core and the negative electrode of the pole core are respectively connected and fixed through the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part, so that the stability of connection between the pole core and the pole core is improved, the overall structural stability of the lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are avoided, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is guaranteed. The invention also provides a lithium ion battery pack comprising the lithium ion battery.

本发明提供了一种锂离子电池，包括第一导电连接部、第二导电连接部和若干极芯，极芯包括正极和负极，所有极芯的正极和负极均卷绕于第一导电连接部的外侧，第一导电连接部和第二导电连接部中的其中一个用于连接并固定若干正极，第一导电连接部和第二导电连接部中的另一个用于连接并固定若干负极。通过第一导电连接部和第二导电连接部分别连接和固定极芯的正极和极芯的负极，而提高了极芯与极芯间连接的稳定性，提高锂离子电池整体的结构稳定性，避免了电解液浸润困难、电池性能较差、循环性能差的缺陷，提高了锂离子电池的浸润效果，从而保障了锂离子电池的循环性能。本发明还提供一种包括锂离子电池的锂离子电池组。

Lithium ion battery and lithium ion battery packTechnical Field

The present invention relates to the field of batteries, and in particular, to a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack.

Background

Along with the development of new energy automobile industry, the lithium ion power battery becomes a mainstream energy storage structure of the new energy automobile, and the energy density and the integration degree of the battery pack are required to be higher and higher, and the long-size lithium ion battery gradually becomes one of the mainstream development directions of the lithium ion battery due to the advantages of high energy density and high integration degree of the battery pack.

The cylindrical battery is lower than the soft package battery or the aluminum shell battery under the same capacity size because the manufacturing equipment is simple and the structural part is low in cost. However, the conventional cylindrical batteries have low capacity, and for a 100kwh power battery used in an electric automobile, several thousands of battery cells need to be connected in series and parallel. Too many series-parallel connections place stringent demands on the reliability of the battery and the consistency of the battery cells.

In the prior art, the capacity of the battery cell is increased by increasing the size or length of the cylindrical battery. However, most of these schemes are simple lengthening pole pieces, the battery structure is not optimized, electrolyte infiltration is difficult, the battery performance, especially the cycle performance is poor, and the overall structure of the battery is unstable.

The Chinese patent with publication number CN 211480207U discloses a long battery cell pole group, a long battery, a battery module and a power battery, wherein the long battery cell pole group comprises a battery cell pole group formed by stacking more than one battery single-stage group, a protection frame is arranged around the battery cell pole group, the protection frame comprises end plates and side plates, the end plates are respectively arranged on two sides of the battery cell pole group in the length direction, the side plates are connected end to end in sequence, a pore canal is formed in each side plate, and the lugs of the battery single-stage group penetrate through the pore canal. The patent plays a role in protecting the battery pack by arranging a protection frame around the battery cell pole group. However, the added protection frame not only occupies the volume of the battery core, thereby correspondingly increasing the volume of the battery shell, increasing the cost and weight of the battery, but also affecting the infiltration effect of the battery.

Therefore, there is a need to provide a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack to solve the above-mentioned problems in the prior art.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack, which are used for solving the problems of unstable battery structure, difficult electrolyte infiltration and poor battery cycle performance caused by overlong length of the existing pole core.

In order to achieve the above object, the lithium ion battery of the present invention includes a first conductive connection portion, a second conductive connection portion, and a plurality of electrode cores, wherein the first conductive connection portion is disposed on an inner side of the electrode core, and the second conductive connection portion is disposed on an outer side of the electrode core;

the pole piece comprises a positive pole and a negative pole, all the positive poles and the negative poles of the pole piece are wound on the outer side of the first conductive connecting portion, one of the first conductive connecting portion and the second conductive connecting portion is used for connecting and fixing a plurality of positive poles, and the other of the first conductive connecting portion and the second conductive connecting portion is used for connecting and fixing a plurality of negative poles.

The lithium ion battery has the beneficial effects that:

according to the lithium ion battery, the first conductive connecting part is arranged on the inner side of the pole core, the second conductive connecting part is arranged on the outer side of the pole core, and the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part are reasonable in arrangement position and small in occupied volume; the positive electrode of the pole core and the negative electrode of the pole core are respectively connected and fixed through the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part, so that the stability of connection between the pole core and the pole core is improved, the overall structural stability of the lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are avoided, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is guaranteed.

Optionally, the pole core is cylindrical in shape.

Optionally, the first conductive connection parts are cylindrical in shape, and the number of the first conductive connection parts is 1;

the inner side surface of the second conductive connecting part is tightly contacted with the outer side surface of the pole core.

Optionally, the lithium ion battery further includes a first tab pad and a second tab pad, one end of each of the electrode cores is provided with the first tab pad, and the other end of each of the electrode cores is provided with the second tab pad.

Optionally, the second lug bonding pad comprises a first bonding pad and a second bonding pad, the positive section of the first bonding pad is in a -shaped structure, and the positive section of the second bonding pad is in an I-shaped structure; the first bonding pad is arranged at one end of the edge, far away from the direction of the adjacent electrode core, of the electrode core, and the second bonding pad is arranged between the two adjacent electrode cores.

Optionally, the first tab pad is sleeved on the outer side of the first conductive connection part, the first pad is fixed and connected with the second conductive connection part on the outer side of the pole core at the edge, and the second pad is fixedly connected with the second conductive connection parts on the outer sides of two adjacent pole cores.

Optionally, one end of the first tab pad is connected to the positive electrode through a positive tab, so as to fixedly connect the positive electrode and the first conductive connection portion. The positive electrode has the beneficial effects that the positive electrode and the first conductive connecting part are connected through the first lug bonding pad, so that the positive electrode of the electrode core is fixed, and the parallel connection of the positive electrodes of a plurality of electrode cores is realized.

Optionally, the end face of the first bonding pad facing the pole core is connected with the negative electrode of the pole core through a negative electrode lug, and two ends of the second bonding pad are respectively connected with the negative electrodes of two adjacent pole cores through negative electrode lugs so as to fixedly connect the negative electrodes with the second conductive connecting part. The cathode and the second conductive connecting part are connected through the first bonding pad and the second bonding pad, so that the cathode of the pole core is fixed, and the parallel connection of the cathodes of a plurality of pole cores is realized.

Optionally, one end of the first tab pad is connected to the negative electrode through a negative electrode tab, so as to fixedly connect the negative electrode and the first conductive connection portion. The cathode and the first conductive connecting part are connected through the first lug bonding pad, so that the cathode of the pole core is fixed, and the parallel connection of the cathodes of a plurality of pole cores is realized.

Optionally, the first bonding pad faces the end face of the pole core and is connected with the positive electrode of the pole core through a positive electrode lug, and two ends of the second bonding pad are respectively connected with the positive electrodes of two adjacent pole cores through positive electrode lugs so as to be fixedly connected with the positive electrode and the second conductive connecting part. The positive electrode and the second conductive connecting part are connected through the first bonding pad and the second bonding pad, so that the positive electrodes of the electrode cores are fixed, and the parallel connection of the positive electrodes of the plurality of electrode cores is realized.

Optionally, the lithium ion battery further includes an insulating component, and the insulating component is disposed between the second conductive connection portion and the first tab pad and between the first tab pad and the second pad. The positive electrode has the beneficial effects that the conduction of the first electrode lug bonding pad and the second bonding pad and the conduction of the first electrode lug bonding pad and the second conductive connecting part are avoided, and the short circuit caused by the conduction of the positive electrode and the negative electrode is avoided.

Optionally, the lithium ion battery further comprises a shell, a first cover plate and a second cover plate, wherein the shell is arranged on the outer side of the second conductive connecting part, and a first opening and a second opening are respectively arranged on two opposite end surfaces of the shell; the first cover plate is arranged at the first opening, a positive pole is arranged on the first cover plate, and the positive pole is connected with the positive pole; the second cover plate is arranged in the second opening, a negative pole column is arranged on the second cover plate, and the negative pole column is connected with the negative pole.

The invention also provides a lithium ion battery pack, which comprises at least two lithium ion batteries, wherein the at least two lithium ion batteries are connected in series or in parallel.

The lithium ion battery pack has the beneficial effects that:

the positive electrode of the pole core and the negative electrode of the pole core are respectively connected and fixed through the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part, so that the stability of connection between the pole core and the pole core is improved, the overall structural stability of the lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are avoided, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is guaranteed.

Detailed Description

For the purpose of making the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present invention more apparent, the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below, and it is apparent that the described embodiments are some embodiments of the present invention, but not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the invention without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the invention. Unless otherwise defined, technical or scientific terms used herein should be given the ordinary meaning as understood by one of ordinary skill in the art to which this invention belongs. As used herein, the word "comprising" and the like means that elements or items preceding the word are included in the element or item listed after the word and equivalents thereof without precluding other elements or items.

In view of the problems existing in the prior art, an embodiment of the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, and fig. 1 is a cross-sectional view of the lithium ion battery in the first embodiment of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1, the lithium ion battery of the present invention includes a first conductive connection part 1, a second conductive connection part 2, and a plurality of electrode cores 3, wherein the first conductive connection part 1 is disposed inside the electrode cores 3, and the second conductive connection part 2 is disposed outside the electrode cores 3;

the electrode core 3 includes a positive electrode 31 and a negative electrode 30, all the positive electrode 31 and the negative electrode 30 of the electrode core 3 are wound on the outer side of the first conductive connection part 1, and the positive electrode 31 and the negative electrode 30 on each electrode core 3 are separated by a separator (not shown).

One of the first conductive connection part 1 and the second conductive connection part 2 is used for connecting and fixing a plurality of positive electrodes 31, and the other of the first conductive connection part 1 and the second conductive connection part 2 is used for connecting and fixing a plurality of negative electrodes 30.

The lithium ion battery has the advantages that: according to the lithium ion battery, the first conductive connecting part 1 is arranged on the inner side of the pole core 3, the second conductive connecting part 2 is arranged on the outer side of the pole core 3, and the first conductive connecting part 1 and the second conductive connecting part 2 are reasonable in arrangement position and small in occupied volume; the positive electrode 31 of the pole core 3 and the negative electrode 30 of the pole core 3 are respectively connected and fixed through the first conductive connecting part 1 and the second conductive connecting part 2, so that the stability of connection between the pole core 3 and the pole core 3 is improved, the overall structural stability of the lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are avoided, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is ensured.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, the pole core 3 has a cylindrical shape, and the ends of two adjacent pole cores 3 are connected to each other, specifically, two adjacent pole cores 3 are connected in parallel, that is, two positive poles 31 of the adjacent pole cores 3 are connected in parallel, and two negative poles 30 of the adjacent pole cores 3 are connected in parallel.

In some embodiments, the pole core 3 is any one of a cylindrical shape, a rectangular cylindrical shape, and an elongated shape.

Fig. 2 is a schematic cross-sectional view of an end portion of a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the invention.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 1 and 2, the first conductive connection parts 1 are cylindrical in shape, the number of the first conductive connection parts 1 is 1, the first conductive connection parts 1 are disposed through the axes of all the electrode cores 3 of the lithium ion battery, and the first conductive connection parts 1 are used for connecting and fixing the positive electrodes 31 or the negative electrodes 30 of all the electrode cores 3;

each of the electrode cores 3 is correspondingly connected with at least one second conductive connection part 2, the inner side surface of the second conductive connection part 2 is in close contact with the outer side surface of the electrode core 3, specifically, the shape of the inner side surface of the second conductive connection part 2 is consistent with the shape of the outer side surface of the electrode core 3 at the contact position of the electrode core 3, for example, when the outer side surface of the electrode core 3 is an arc surface, the inner side surface of the second conductive connection part 2 is also an arc surface, and the second conductive connection part 2 is used for fixing the positive electrode 31 or the negative electrode 30 positioned at the outer side of the electrode core 3, so that the whole packaging volume of the lithium ion battery is saved.

It may be added that a gap or a groove may be provided between the second conductive connection portions 2 and the pole cores 3 as required, for example, a plurality of second conductive connection portions 2 are provided at intervals on the outer side of each pole core 3, referring to fig. 2, each pole core 3 is correspondingly connected with two second conductive connection portions 2, and a gap 22 is formed between two adjacent second conductive connection portions 2 on the same pole core 3; or a groove 21 is formed on the inner side surface or the side part of the second conductive connection part 2, so that an electrolyte channel is formed between the second conductive connection part 2 and the pole core 3, thereby improving the electrolyte infiltration efficiency and improving the electrolyte infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery.

In some embodiments, referring to fig. 2, the shape of the pole core 3 is consistent with the shape of the first conductive connection part 1, and is any one of a cylindrical shape, a rectangular cylindrical shape and an elongated shape; the first conductive connecting part 1 is positioned at the axis of the pole core 3, and the first conductive connecting part 1 is coaxial with the pole core 3.

Fig. 3 is a schematic front sectional structure of a first tab pad according to an embodiment of the present invention, and fig. 4 is a schematic cross-sectional structure of an end face of the first tab pad and a first conductive connection portion according to an embodiment of the present invention.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, the lithium ion battery described with reference to fig. 1, 3 and 4 further includes a first tab pad 4 and a second tab pad 5, and one end portion of each of the tabs 3 is provided with the first tab pad 4.

Fig. 5 is a schematic front sectional structure of a first bonding pad according to an embodiment of the present invention, fig. 6 is a schematic front sectional structure of a second bonding pad according to an embodiment of the present invention, and fig. 7 is a schematic cross-sectional structure of an end face of a second ear bonding pad and a first conductive connection portion according to an embodiment of the present invention.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 5 to 7, the second ear pad 5 includes a first pad 51 and a second pad 52, the first pad 51 has a "" shape in a positive section, and the second pad 52 has an "i" shape; the second bonding pad 52 is connected between the connection ends of two adjacent pole cores 3, and the first bonding pad 51 is disposed at one end of the edge pole core 3 away from the direction of the adjacent pole core.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 1, the first tab pad 4 is sleeved on the outer side of the first conductive connection portion 1, the inner side surface of the first pad 51 is fixed and connected to the second conductive connection portion 2 on the outer side of the electrode core 3 at the edge, and the inner side surface of the second pad 52 is fixedly connected to the second conductive connection portions 2 on the outer sides of two adjacent electrode cores. Two adjacent second conductive connection parts 2 are fixed by the second pads 52, thereby functioning as conductive connection and fixation.

Referring to fig. 4 and 7, the first tab pad 4, the first pad 51, and the second pad 52 have an overall shape of a ring in side view, and the first tab pad 4, the first pad 51, and the second pad 52 each have a through hole 40 therein to allow the first conductive connection portion 1 to pass through.

In some embodiments, referring to fig. 1, a notch 20 is provided at an end of the second conductive connection portion 2, and the shape of the notch 20 is consistent with the shapes of the sides of the second pad 52 and the first pad 51, so that the sides of the second pad 52 and the first pad 51 are conveniently embedded into the notch 20, so that the outer side surfaces of the first pad 51 and the second pad 52 do not protrude out of the outer surface of the second conductive connection portion 2, the surface flatness of the fixed electrode core 3 is ensured, and the volume occupied by the lithium ion battery is also saved.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 1, the lithium ion battery further includes a housing 6, a first cover plate 61 and a second cover plate 62, the housing 6 is disposed on the outer side of the second conductive connection part 2, and opposite end surfaces of the housing 6 are respectively provided with a first opening and a second opening; the first cover plate 61 is disposed in the first opening, a positive pole column 312 is disposed on the first cover plate 61, and the positive pole column 312 is connected with the positive pole 31; the second cover plate 62 is disposed in the second opening, a negative electrode column 302 is disposed on the second cover plate 62, and the negative electrode column 302 is connected with the negative electrode 30.

In some possible embodiments of the present invention, referring to fig. 1, in a first embodiment of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, one end of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the positive electrode 31 through a positive tab 311 to fixedly connect the positive electrode 31 and the first conductive connection portion 1, so as to fix the positive electrode 31 of the electrode core 3, and realize parallel connection of the positive electrodes 31 of a plurality of the electrode cores 3;

the first bonding pad 51 faces the end face of the pole core and is connected with the negative electrode 30 of the pole core 3 through the negative electrode lug 301, two ends of the second bonding pad 52 are respectively connected with the negative electrodes 30 of two adjacent pole cores through the negative electrode lug 301 so as to fixedly connect the negative electrodes 30 with the second conductive connecting part 2, thereby realizing the fixation of the negative electrodes 30 of the pole core and realizing the parallel connection of a plurality of the negative electrodes 30 of the pole core.

In some embodiments, the first conductive connection part 1 and the second conductive connection part 2 are made of conductive materials, preferably, the first conductive connection part 1 connected to the positive electrode 31 is made of aluminum materials, and the second conductive connection part 2 connected to the negative electrode 30 is made of graphite materials.

In some specific embodiments, the end portion of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the positive tab 311 by a welding manner, the inner side of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the first conductive connection portion 1 by a welding manner, and one end of the first conductive connection portion 1 is connected to the positive post 312 by a welding manner, so as to electrically connect and fix the positive electrode 31, the positive tab 311, the first tab pad 4, the first conductive connection portion 1 and the positive post 312;

two ends of the second bonding pad 52 are respectively connected with the negative electrode lugs 301 of two adjacent electrode cores 3 in a welding manner, and the inner side of each second bonding pad 52 is connected with two adjacent second conductive connecting parts 2 in a welding manner;

one end of the first bonding pad 51 is connected with the negative electrode lug 301 of the leftmost electrode core 3 in a welding mode, the inner side of the first bonding pad 51 is connected with the second conductive connecting part 2 on the outer side of the leftmost electrode core 3 in a welding mode, one end of the first bonding pad 51 is connected with the negative electrode column 302 in a welding mode, and fixing and electric connection of the negative electrode 30, the negative electrode lug 301, the first bonding pad 51, the second bonding pad 52, the second conductive connecting part 2 and the negative electrode column 302 are achieved.

Fig. 8 is a cross-sectional view of a lithium-ion battery in accordance with a second embodiment of the invention.

In some possible embodiments of the present invention, referring to fig. 8, the lithium ion battery in the second embodiment shown in fig. 8 is different from the lithium ion battery in the first embodiment shown in fig. 1 in that: one end of the first tab pad 4 in the second embodiment shown in fig. 8 is connected to the negative electrode 30 through a negative electrode tab 301 to fixedly connect the negative electrode 30 and the first conductive connection portion 1, thereby realizing fixation of the negative electrode 30 of the electrode core 3 and parallel connection of the negative electrodes 30 of the plurality of electrode cores 3;

the first bonding pad 51 faces the end face of the pole core 3 and is connected with the positive electrode 31 of the pole core 3 through the positive electrode lug 311, two ends of the second bonding pad 52 are respectively connected with the positive electrodes 31 of the adjacent two pole cores 3 through the positive electrode lug 311 so as to fixedly connect the positive electrodes 31 with the second conductive connecting part 2, so that the positive electrodes 31 of the pole cores 3 are fixed, and the parallel connection of the positive electrodes 31 of the plurality of pole cores 3 is realized.

In some embodiments, the first conductive connection part 1 connected to the negative electrode 30 is made of graphite material, and the second conductive connection part 2 connected to the positive electrode 31 is made of aluminum foil material.

In some specific embodiments, the end of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the negative electrode tab 301 by welding, the inner side surface of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the first conductive connection part 1 by welding, and the first conductive connection part 1 is connected to the negative electrode post 302 by welding, so as to electrically connect and fix the negative electrode 30, the negative electrode tab 301, the first tab pad 4, the first conductive connection part 1 and the negative electrode post 302;

the two end parts of the second bonding pads 52 are connected with the positive lugs 311 of the two adjacent pole cores 3 in a welding mode, and the inner side surface of each second bonding pad 52 is connected with two adjacent second conductive connecting parts 2 in a welding mode;

the end of the first bonding pad 51 is connected with the anode lug 311 through a welding mode with the electrode core 3 positioned at the leftmost end, the inner side of the first bonding pad 51 is connected with the second conductive connecting part 2 at the outer side of the leftmost electrode core 3 through a welding mode, one end of the first bonding pad 51 is connected with the anode column 312 through a welding mode, and the fixing and electric connection of the anode 31, the anode lug 311, the first bonding pad 51, the second bonding pad 52, the second conductive connecting part 2 and the anode column 312 are realized.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 1 and 8, the lithium ion battery further includes an insulating member 7, and the insulating member 7 is disposed between the second conductive connection part 2 and the first tab pad 4 and between the first tab pad 4 and the second pad 52. The advantage is that the electrical conduction between the first tab pad 4 and the second pad 52 and between the first tab pad 4 and the second conductive connection part 2 are avoided, and the short circuit caused by the conduction between the positive electrode 31 and the negative electrode 30 is avoided.

In some embodiments, the insulation component 7 has a "" shape in the front section, and the insulation component 7 is enclosed on the outer side of the first tab pad 4, so that electrical conduction between the second conductive connection part 2 and the second pad 52 and the first tab pad 4 is avoided, and short circuit of the battery is avoided. The insulation of the structure is realized through one structure, so that the cost and the volume are saved, and the weight of the battery is saved.

In some embodiments, the constituent material of the insulating assembly 7 comprises plastic.

The invention also provides a lithium ion battery pack, which comprises at least two lithium ion batteries, wherein the at least two lithium ion batteries are connected in series or in parallel.

The lithium ion battery pack has the advantages that: the positive electrode of the pole core and the negative electrode of the pole core are respectively connected and fixed through the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part, so that the stability of connection between the pole core and the pole core is improved, the overall structural stability of the lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are avoided, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is guaranteed.

While embodiments of the present invention have been described in detail hereinabove, it will be apparent to those skilled in the art that various modifications and variations can be made to these embodiments. It is to be understood that such modifications and variations are within the scope and spirit of the present invention as set forth in the following claims. Moreover, the invention described herein is capable of other embodiments and of being practiced or of being carried out in various ways.
